ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback! We are sorry to hear about your experience with your grates. Glad to hear our support team could assist you with this. It's very common to see a substance on your grates, that look like peeling or flaking paint, or some sort of finish that is delaminating. However, we don't apply any paint or finish to our grate that can peel in the manner you described. The high heat of the grill will cause the deposits to harden, and it will begin to flake or peel off. Carbonized grease is non-toxic. For future reference to remove the carbonized grease simply preheat the grill on high for 15 minutes, with the lid closed, and then brush the grates with a stainless steel grill brush. If you have any other question, please contact our support team. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText:
True to the Weber name, this is an excellent little barbecue. It was purchased for car camping trips and did not disappoint. It folds up for easier storage and with the addition of an adapter hose I can use it with a large refillable propane tank versus a small disposable. My one small criticism is that it only has one burner so there is no option to cook over indirect heat but then again this is being used for camping and this almost a non-issue. 

This barbecue is tough and sturdy and looks sleek. Worth the money.
Results.Title: Excellent Barbecue

Results.ReviewText: This is a nice little portable grill for our trips. It's big enough for us and is same quality as our main Weber. It cooks well and it's easy to clean. The only thing that I wish was offered was a quick connect hose without a regulator for RVs, which already have a regulator in the gas line. We had to take off the one on it and find the right hose on Amazon to use it with our camper. I expect a large percent of the people who buy these little units are using them this way.

Results.ReviewText: Best purchase! We take ours camping. So compact and easy to pack up! Even flame, which makes it easy to cook with.

Results.ReviewText:
I really love this Weber Q. We use it camping & football tailgate parties. I purchased the griddle as well. We do pancakes & eggs on the griddle side & sausages on the grill side. It is great.
I would have rated this 5 stars, but I just had a problem with the Q. The regulator went bad, after only about 4 years. (Off warranty) I had another grill before this one for 30 years & never replaced the regulator. The regulator cost me $60! Well, it is now up & running again.

Results.ReviewText: Great grill cooks fast.  Get the adapter (optional) to hook up to larger 20 pound tank if cooking a lot.  Great quality  love the cover (optional).
Results.Title: Grill 1200

Results.ReviewText: I absolutely love love love this grill. It is perfect for my needs and has plenty of room to grill food to feed 2-4 depending on what you're making. Incredibly easy to put together. I also purchased the cart so it would be at a good cooking height and have its own spot. It heats up super fast and I am using it multiple times a week. I live in the city and this is perfect on my small outdoor space.
Results.Title: Perfect Grill for Small Spaces

Results.ReviewText: This is a nice little unit for those of us that don't need a full-size grill.  I am new to Weber Grills always being concerned regarding that Weber Grills are usually more expensive than their counterparts.  The grates for this unit are not like I am use to in that they are plates.  They get very hot.  I was concerned with the amount of heat generated and made my concern known to Weber's support group.  Without any question they stated that they would send me a new regulator.  Now I understand based on this effort to allay my concern, why users of Weber Grills whole heartedly praise their products.  I am now getting use to the grill and I can say with a new regulator installed I am getting use to how to grill with this unit.  Thank-you Weber for standing by your product and helping me understand how to be a better cook.
Results.Title: Great Little Unit

Results.ReviewText: Great little BBQ. Heats up quickly and keeps it’s temp, even after lifting the lid to flip or move food around on the grill. Very happy with it.
Results.Title: Works like a charm!

Results.ReviewText: I used my grill for the first time Sat. & love it, BUT, wish you had numbers or "low, medium, high" on knob.  Grill went up to 500 before I could regulate it.
Results.Title: Love it!

Results.ReviewText: Yes we love it, compact, stores easily. And easy to clean.
Results.Title: Colour Red

Results.ReviewText:
We bought our Weber Q 1200 gas barbeque and having np been using it 3-4 times a week. It is a perfect size for the condo balcony and we hope to use it at a picnic later this summer…great portability.
The barbeque lights easily with the push button starter, heats very quickly and is ready to use in a few minutes. The 2 large grilling plates are a great size for our veggies and main course. We have cooked chicken, steak, salmon and lots of veggies and enjoyed each meal. Easy to clean the grilling plates, the dripping tray and inside of the gas grill. We clean it each time we use it and the grill looks like new. We were attracted by the size, blue coloured lid, price and light weight of the grill.  Perfect for our condo terrace.
Results.Title: Fantastic Size & Performance

The only accessory I wish it had, was some sort of a cooking/warming rack, even a small one would do. Cooking a foil pack, one really has to pay close attention and cook on LOW. Any ideas out there??
